description.en: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en.

description.en: The ID of the health check configuration. You can call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPool](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspool) operation to obtain the ID.

description.zh:
开启状态：

- OPEN：开启
- CLOSE：关闭
description.en:
The status to set for the health check. Valid values:

- OPEN: Enables the health check.

- CLOSE: Disables the health check.

title.zh: 设置 DNS 地址池健康检查状态

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns set-dns-gtm-monitor-status --lang en --monitor-config-id Monito00000 --status OPEN --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns SetDnsGtmMonitorStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status OPEN --Lang en --MonitorConfigId Monito00000
